raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Motivation This PR adds two performance optimizations aimed at FLUX.2-dev. - **The adaLN modulate runs eager on ROCm.** FLUX.2 fuses LayerNorm and the adaLN modulate into one kernel on NV, but that path is gated to cuda: the kernel uses inline PTX for correctly-rounded division and rsqrt, which LLVM rejects outright on AMD. So on ROCm every adaLN site falls back to `LN(x) * (1 + scale) + shift`. Porting that kernel would not help either: its bit-exactness contract reproduces aten's 32-lane warp reduction, and gfx950 warps are 64 wide. Instead this gives FLUX.2 the third tier FLUX.1 already has. Aten LayerNorm followed by the fused `modulate_scale_shift`. This alone gets most of the way there. The difference between porting the NV feature and incurring the output regression vs this is marginal, benchmarked to be within 0.5% - not worth the bit-exactness loss. - **The Ulysses exchange copies Q/K/V apart for no reason.** The packed exchange returns one interleaved `[.., 3 * head_size]` buffer and splits it into three contiguous tensors. AITER's FMHA reads Q/K/V through explicit strides and returns bit-identical output from the interleaved views, so those three copies only cost bandwidth. ## Modifications **Fused adaLN modulate on ROCm** - `kernels/jit/csrc/diffusion/modulate_scale_shift.cuh` — add `#pragma clang fp contract(off)` on the HIP path in `modulate_value`, so the bf16 rounding boundary between the multiply and the add survives. Without it hipcc folds the pair into an FMA and the kernel stops matching the rounding chain it documents. - `kernels/ops/diffusion/modulate/modulate_scale_shift_jit.py` — drop the `torch.version.hip is not None` rejection from `can_use_modulate_scale_shift_cuda`, so the fast path serves both backends. - `multimodal_gen/runtime/models/dits/flux_2.py` — add `_flux2_norm_then_modulate` (aten LayerNorm, then the fused modulate) and route both fallbacks in `_flux2_norm_modulate` through it: the one taken when the single-kernel LN+modulate is unavailable, and the one taken when that kernel raises. The compile and graph-capture branches stay on the plain eager expression, and the bit-exactness reference is unchanged. - `test/registered/kernels/ops/diffusion/test_modulate.py` — the two cases that asserted ROCm must *not* take the fast path now assert the same contract on both backends. **Strided QKV handoff** - `multimodal_gen/runtime/layers/attention/backends/attention_backend.py` — add `AttentionImpl.accepts_strided_qkv`, default `False`: whether a backend reads Q/K/V through explicit strides. - `multimodal_gen/runtime/layers/attention/backends/aiter.py` — `AITerImpl` sets it to `True`. It is the only backend that does. - `multimodal_gen/runtime/layers/usp.py` — `_usp_input_all_to_all_qkv` gains a kw-only `allow_strided_qkv` (default `False`). When set it returns the three interleaved views instead of copying them apart, and the receive buffer alternates between two staging roles through `_packed_qkv_recv_role`, so views handed to attention stay valid past the next collective. - `multimodal_gen/runtime/layers/attention/layer.py` — the plain Ulysses handoff opts in only when `get_ring_parallel_world_size() <= 1` and the impl declares support. The ring path, which reshapes and chunks Q/K/V, keeps the copies. - `multimodal_gen/test/unit/test_usp_packed_qkv_a2a.py` — two cases: the strided views are bitwise equal to the copied path (a wrong stride would silently read a neighbouring projection rather than fail), and successive strided exchanges name different staging roles. ## Accuracy Tests Bit-identical output during all steps, so showing just one image. ## Speed Tests and Profiling Measured on 8xMI355X. #### Per-site, at the production shapes | site | before | after | speedup | |---|---|---|---| | adaLN modulate, 81 sites/step | 29.1 us | 18.5 us | 1.69x | | `modulate_scale_shift` kernel alone | 26.1 us | 8.9 us | 2.92x | | QKV copies removed, 56 calls/step | 22.0 us | 0 | - | #### e2e | step | mean (s) | delta | |---|---|---| | base | 4.104 | | | + fused adaLN modulate | 4.059 | **-1.10%** | | + strided QKV handoff | 3.996 | **-1.56%** | | **combined** | **3.996** | **-2.64%** | ## Checklist - [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). - [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). - [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). - [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). - [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance). ## Review and Merge Process 1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process). 3. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers. 5. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so. - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci` 6. +# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""AITer attention over the Ulysses exchange must not depend on Q/K/V being
+copied apart.
+
+``AttentionImpl.accepts_strided_qkv`` lets the packed exchange hand AITer three
+views into one interleaved ``[.., 3 * head_size]`` receive buffer instead of
+three contiguous copies. Both carry the same values, so only running the kernel
+proves the strides reach it: a backend that ignores a stride reads a
+neighbouring projection's rows and returns a plausible, wrong result rather
+than failing.
+
+    pytest -v python/sglang/multimodal_gen/test/single_test_file/test_usp_strided_qkv_aiter_2_gpu.py
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.platforms import current_platform
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase, find_available_port
+
+_WORLD = 2
+# Four exchanges per layout: the strided path alternates between two receive
+# buffers, so a buffer recycled too early shows up from the second step on.
+_STEPS = 4
+_B, _S_LOCAL, _H, _D = 1, 256, 8, 128
+
+
+def _make_shards(layout: str, step: int, *, rank: int, world: int, device):
+    """This rank's ``[B, S_local, H, D]`` Q/K/V shards of a shared global tensor.
+
+    ``merged_projection`` is the FLUX.2 layout: three chunks of one packed
+    projection, so the shards reaching the pack kernel are themselves strided.
+    """
+    generator = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(1000 + step)
+    s_global = _S_LOCAL * world
+    rows = slice(rank * _S_LOCAL, (rank + 1) * _S_LOCAL)
+    if layout == "contiguous":
+        return tuple(
+            torch.randn(_B, s_global, _H, _D, generator=generator)
+            .to(device, torch.bfloat16)[:, rows]
+            .contiguous()
+            for _ in range(3)
+        )
+    hidden = torch.randn(_B, s_global, 3 * _H * _D, generator=generator).to(
+        device, torch.bfloat16
+    )
+    return tuple(t[:, rows].unflatten(-1, (_H, _D)) for t in hidden.chunk(3, dim=-1))
+
+
+def _build_attention(device):
+    """A USPAttention wired to a real AITerImpl, without the model-level config.
+
+    The constructor resolves the backend through the global runtime context; the
+    fields below are the ones the dense Ulysses path reads.
+    """
+    import sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.layer as L
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.backends.aiter import AITerImpl
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.platforms.interface import AttentionBackendEnum
+
+    scale = _D**-0.5
+    attn = L.USPAttention.__new__(L.USPAttention)
+    attn.attn_impl = AITerImpl(
+        num_heads=_H,
+        head_size=_D,
+        softmax_scale=scale,
+        causal=False,
+        num_kv_heads=_H,
+    )
+    attn.backend = AttentionBackendEnum.AITER
+    attn.softmax_scale = scale
+    attn.causal = False
+    attn.dropout_p = 0.0
+    attn.dtype = torch.bfloat16
+    attn.num_heads = _H
+    attn.head_size = _D
+    attn.num_kv_heads = _H
+    attn.skip_sequence_parallel = False
+    attn.enable_packed_qkv_input_a2a = False
+    attn.is_cross_attention = False
+    attn.capture_dense_attention = False
+    attn.allow_cudnn_sdp = False
+    attn.sp_attention_mode = "ulysses"
+    attn.sp_attention_mode_is_auto = False
+    attn._pipeline_declined = set()
+    return attn
+
+
+def _run_layout(attn, *, strided: bool, layout: str, rank: int, world: int, device):
+    """Returns the per-step outputs and whether each call saw contiguous Q/K/V."""
+    attn.attn_impl.accepts_strided_qkv = strided
+    kernel_saw_contiguous: list[bool] = []
+    impl_forward = type(attn.attn_impl).forward
+
+    def recording_forward(query, key, value, metadata):
+        kernel_saw_contiguous.append(
+            query.is_contiguous() and key.is_contiguous() and value.is_contiguous()
+        )
+        return impl_forward(attn.attn_impl, query, key, value, metadata)

+    attn.attn_impl.forward = recording_forward
+    outputs = []
+    with torch.inference_mode():
+        for step in range(_STEPS):
+            q, k, v = _make_shards(layout, step, rank=rank, world=world, device=device)
+            outputs.append(attn.forward(q, k, v).clone())
+    del attn.attn_impl.forward

+        if not usp_mod._can_use_packed_qkv_a2a_4d(*probe, world):
+            failures.append(f"{layout}: unpacked fallback taken, nothing to compare")
+            continue

+        strided_out, strided_contiguous = _run_layout(
+            attn, strided=True, layout=layout, rank=rank, world=world, device=device
+        )
+        copied_out, copied_contiguous = _run_layout(
+            attn, strided=False, layout=layout, rank=rank, world=world, device=device
+        )

+        if any(strided_contiguous):

+                f"{layout}: strided path handed AITer contiguous Q/K/V "
+                f"({strided_contiguous}); the comparison proves nothing"
+            )
+        if not all(copied_contiguous):

+                f"{layout}: copying path handed AITer strided Q/K/V "
+                f"({copied_contiguous})"
+            )
+        for step, (got, want) in enumerate(zip(strided_out, copied_out)):
